title: 第 17 章 刁难升级步步紧逼第 19 章 圣女问询一语点醒
slug: 朽道归墟我以残灵证长生
lines: 清晨的风刚暖了一点，就被一阵杂乱的脚步声搅得乱了。
墓园入口的荒草被踩得东倒西歪，七八个外门弟子拨开晨雾，骂骂咧咧地走了进来，为首的正是赵峰。他脸上的绷带还没拆，左边胳膊吊在胸前，上次被林寂打出来的伤还没好，眼神里的怨毒却浓得能滴出水来，手里攥着一把长刀，刀鞘磕在荒坟的石头上，发出哐当的响，在安静的墓园里格外刺耳。
太阳已经升得很高了，金光穿过稀薄的雾，洒在这群人身上，把他们的影子拉得老长，挡在了林寂的断碑前，把原本照在林寂身上的阳光，彻底挡住了。
林寂刚收完功，正擦着脸上的汗，看到这群人，他连眉毛都没动一下，只是平静地看着他们。
他早就料到了，赵峰吃了那么大的亏，肯定不会善罢甘休，只是没想到，他们这么快就来了。
赵峰走到林寂面前，上下打量了他一眼，看到他一身洗得发白的旧衣服，看到他手里那个空了的白瓷瓶，嘴角扯出一抹极其轻蔑的笑，吐了口唾沫在地上：“哟，废人，你还没死呢？我还以为你被煞气啃了骨头了。”
跟在他身后的几个弟子立刻就哄笑了起来，声音很大，震得周围的荒草都晃了晃。
林寂没说话，只是看着他，眼神平静得像水。
赵峰被他看得有点不舒服，他本来以为林寂会怕，会躲，会求饶，可是没想到，这个废人居然敢这么看着他，好像根本没把他放在眼里一样。
他心里的火一下子就上来了，往前迈了一步，指着林寂的鼻子骂：“你他妈看什么看？一个废人，也敢这么看老子？我告诉你，今天老子来，是要抓你这个邪修去见长老的！”
林寂挑了挑眉，终于开口了，声音很淡：“邪修？我怎么就成邪修了？”
“怎么成邪修了？”赵峰嗤笑了一声，从怀里掏出一个空了的丹药瓶，举起来给周围的人看，“大家看看！这是宗门的凝气丹！昨天宗门药库丢了十瓶凝气丹，我查了半天，原来是你这个废人偷的！你一个废人，哪来的钱买净气丹？肯定是你偷了丹药，卖了钱买的！”
他身后的几个弟子立刻就跟着起哄：“原来是他偷的！我说药库怎么会丢东西呢！”“果然是邪修！手脚都不干净！”“抓他去见长老！把他废了赶出去！”
林寂看着那个丹药瓶，忍不住笑了。
他算是看明白了，这根本就是赵峰设的局。他打不过自己，就想诬陷自己偷丹药，坐实自己的罪名，把自己彻底赶出青云宗，甚至是废了自己的修为。
好得很，真是好得很。
林寂的眼神，一点点冷了下来。
“赵峰，你说是我偷的，有证据吗？”林寂的声音很平，没有起伏。
“证据？”赵峰指了指他，“你一个废人，守在这破坟地，哪来的净气丹？不是偷的是什么？还有，你能操控坟地的煞气，你不是邪修是什么？我告诉你，昨天我来这里，你就用邪术伤我，今天你还偷宗门的丹药，罪加一等！”
他身后的王虎，那个之前一直劝他的矮胖弟子，这时候拉了拉他的袖子，小声说：“峰哥，算了吧，没有证据，我们这么说，长老也不会信的...”
“信个屁！”赵峰一把甩开他的手，骂道，“你懂个屁！长老本来就怀疑他是邪修，只要我们把他抓回去，打一顿，他肯定就招了！到时候我们就是除邪的功臣，长老还能亏待我们？”
王虎张了张嘴，还想说什么，但是看到赵峰那副凶样子，终究还是没敢说，只是往后退了半步，不敢说话了。
其他的几个弟子，却都眼睛亮了，他们都想着，要是能除掉这个邪修，就能得到长老的赏赐，一个个都摩拳擦掌的，看着林寂，像看着猎物一样。
赵峰看着林寂，脸上露出了得意的笑：“废人，我劝你最好乖乖束手就擒，跟我去见长老，不然的话，老子今天就打断你的腿，把你拖回去！”
林寂看着他，突然笑了，笑得很轻，却带着一丝冰冷的嘲讽：“就凭你？”
赵峰愣了一下，随即就怒了，他没想到这个废人居然还敢嘴硬！他怒吼了一声：“好！好得很！看来你是不见棺材不掉泪！给我上！把他给我抓起来！”
话音刚落，那几个弟子就拿着刀，朝着林寂冲了过来，刀上带着灵力，闪着寒光，看起来凶得很。
林寂站在原地，动都没动。

The morning wind had just warmed up a little when it was disturbed by the sound of chaotic footsteps.
The grass at the entrance to the cemetery was trampled to pieces. Seven or eight outer disciples pushed through the morning fog and walked in cursing. The leader was none other than Zhao Feng. The bandage on his face has not been removed, and his left arm is hanging on his chest. The injury from Lin Ji's last time has not healed yet, but the resentment in his eyes is so thick that it can drip water. He is holding a long knife in his hand, and the scabbard hits the stone of the barren grave, making a clanging sound, which is particularly harsh in the quiet cemetery.
The sun had risen very high, and the golden light passed through the thin fog and shone on the group of people, stretching their shadows so long that they stood in front of Lin Ji's broken monument, completely blocking the sunlight that originally shone on Lin Ji.
Lin Ji had just finished his work and was wiping the sweat from his face. When he saw this group of people, he didn't even move his eyebrows and just looked at them calmly.
He had already expected that Zhao Feng would not let it go after suffering such a big loss, but he did not expect that they would come so soon.
Zhao Feng walked up to Lin Ji and looked him up and down. When he saw that he was wearing old washed clothes and the empty white porcelain bottle in his hand, he pulled out an extremely contemptuous smile and spat on the ground: "Hey, useless person, you are not dead yet? I thought your bones were chewed by the evil spirit."
Several disciples following him immediately burst into laughter, the sound was so loud that it shook the surrounding grass.
Lin Ji didn't say anything, just looked at him, her eyes as calm as water.
Zhao Feng felt a little uncomfortable when he looked at him. He originally thought that Lin Ji would be afraid, hide, and beg for mercy, but he didn't expect that this useless man would dare to look at him like this, as if he didn't take him seriously at all.
The fire in his heart suddenly rose. He took a step forward, pointed at Lin Ji's nose and cursed: "What the hell are you looking at? How dare a useless person look at me like this? Let me tell you, today I am here to catch you, an evil cultivator, to see the elders!"
Lin Ji raised her eyebrows and finally spoke, her voice was very low: "Evil cultivator? Why did I become an evil cultivator?"
"Why did you become an evil cultivator?" Zhao Feng sneered, took out an empty elixir bottle from his arms, and held it up to show to the people around him, "Everyone, look! This is the sect's Qi Condensation Pill! Yesterday, the sect's medicine warehouse lost ten bottles of Qi Condensation Pill. I checked for a long time, and it turned out that you, a useless person, stole it! You are a useless person, where did you get the money to buy the Qi Purifying Pill? You must have stolen the pill and sold it to buy it!"
Several disciples behind him immediately started shouting: "It turns out he stole it! How could things be lost in the medicine warehouse?" "He is indeed an evil cultivator! His hands and feet are not clean!" "Catch him and go to the elders! Destroy him and drive him out!"
Lin Ji looked at the pill bottle and couldn't help but laugh.
He finally understood that this was basically a trap set by Zhao Feng. He couldn't beat himself, so he wanted to frame himself for stealing the elixir, prove his crime, drive himself out of the Qingyun Sect, and even destroy his own cultivation.
Very, very good.
Lin Ji's eyes became colder a little bit.
"Zhao Feng, you said I stole it, do you have any evidence?" Lin Ji's voice was calm, without any fluctuations.
"Evidence?" Zhao Feng pointed at him, "You are a loser, guarding this ruined cemetery, where did you get the Purifying Pill? What else did you steal? Also, you can control the evil spirit in the cemetery, so what are you if you are not an evil cultivator? Let me tell you, when I came here yesterday, you used evil magic to hurt me, and today you stole the sect's elixir, so your crime is even higher!"
Behind him, Wang Hu, the pudgy disciple who had been persuading him before, pulled his sleeve and whispered: "Brother Feng, forget it, there is no evidence, even if we say this, the elders won't believe it..."
"What a bullshit!" Zhao Feng threw his hand away and cursed, "You know what a bullshit! The elder already suspected that he was an evil cultivator. As long as we catch him back and beat him up, he will definitely do it! By then we will be the hero of eliminating evil, how can the elder treat us badly?"
Wang Hu opened his mouth and wanted to say something, but after seeing Zhao Feng's fierce look, he still didn't dare to speak. He just took a half step back, not daring to speak.
The eyes of the other disciples were bright. They all thought that if they could get rid of this evil cultivator, they would be rewarded by the elders. They were all eager to look at Lin Ji as if they were prey.
Zhao Feng looked at Lin Ji with a proud smile on his face: "Cruel, I advise you to surrender and follow me to see the elders. Otherwise, I will break your legs today and drag you back!"
Lin Ji looked at him and suddenly laughed, very softly, but with a hint of cold ridicule: "Just you?"
Zhao Feng was stunned for a moment, and then became angry. He didn't expect that this loser would dare to speak harshly! He roared angrily: "Okay! Very good! It seems you won't shed tears until you see the coffin! Come on! Catch him!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the disciples rushed towards Lin Ji with swords in their hands. The swords were filled with spiritual power and shone with a cold light, looking very fierce.
Lin Ji stood there, not moving.
